title: A Novel Ahead of Its Time
text:
Few novels from the nineteenth century have attracted as much critical debate as Wuthering Heights. Emily Brontë's only novel was published in 1847 under a male pseudonym, and early reviewers were unsettled by its violence and its unreliable narrators. Over time, however, critics came to see the book as a daring exploration of obsession and social class. Its structure, which relies on nested stories told by different characters, has been praised for its ambiguity.

Early reviewers focused on the novel's cruelty, but modern readers often appreciate its emotional complexity. The story is narrated largely through Mr. Lockwood and the housekeeper Nelly Dean, which means the reader must judge how reliable each account is. Many scholars argue that this layered narration is the novel's greatest achievement. Adaptations for film and television have repeatedly tried to capture this complexity, though few have managed it fully.

paragraph_translations: Pocas novelas del siglo XIX han despertado tanto debate crítico como Cumbres borrascosas. La única novela de Emily Brontë se publicó en 1847 bajo un seudónimo masculino, y los primeros críticos se sintieron inquietos por su violencia y sus narradores poco fiables. Con el tiempo, sin embargo, la crítica llegó a ver el libro como una exploración audaz de la obsesión y la clase social. Su estructura, que se basa en historias anidadas contadas por distintos personajes, ha sido elogiada por su ambigüedad.

Los primeros críticos se centraron en la crueldad de la novela, pero los lectores modernos suelen apreciar su complejidad emocional. La historia se narra en gran parte a través del señor Lockwood y de la ama de llaves Nelly Dean, lo que obliga al lector a juzgar qué tan fiable es cada relato. Muchos especialistas sostienen que esta narración en capas es el mayor logro de la novela. Las adaptaciones para cine y televisión han intentado repetidamente capturar esta complejidad, aunque pocas lo han logrado por completo.
